title: An old theater
content: So for some context, I’m a musical theatre performer and I live in NYC, so I’ve frequented all the theaters around Times Square. Some of them are older, some of them have been redone and look a lot newer, but not a single one looks like the old theater I enter in my dreams (usually nightmares). It’s always the same old theater, there’s voms on either side of the orchestra audience section, a mezzanine, and a balcony (for anyone wondering—voms are entrances to the stage that come from under the audience, so it gives shows a more immersive feel because it looks like the actors are literally rising from the audience to enter the stage). The stage, orchestra, and balcony sections are very old and dark, like decrepit, but the mezzanine is shockingly new, white, linoleum, and it’s always very brightly lit unlike the rest of the theater. I’ve been in the mezzanine a few times but I always get a sense of panic when I’m in there, but usually I’m onstage and I can see people dressed identical with their faces covered by masks standing at the railing of the mezzanine looking at me. It almost feels like the mezzanine is actually from the Backrooms and SCP foundation—except I’ve been having this dream for years and just recently found out what those two things were. Coming across this sub makes me wonder if the mezzanine is actually part of the Mall, just cause some of y’all’s descriptions match the aesthetic pretty closely. But idk! This location is usually something I visit during a dream, it’s not my whole dream, but it’s always when my dream starts to get more panicky. Sometimes it’s something stupid like we’re doing a show and I have to go onstage but I don’t remember what we rehearsed or what my lines are. But most of the time, it feels like the people in the mezzanine are watching me and my cast mates, trying to decide who they want to pick for their weird experiments. I’ve never been picked, but I’ve had cast mates disappear over the course of the dream and the stage manager just solemnly goes, “oh they got picked.” It’s bizarre and creepy, but I know if I’m ever in the mezzanine I just need to get out. Anywho if you made it this far, thanks for reading! If anyone else knows of this old theater, I wanna hear about it.
